messages:
maria (Marketing): Draft uploaded — full product launch post is in the doc (link). focus is on the 'tech playbook' angle: inference economics, routing decisions, and a short how-to for getting started.
sam (Growth): skimmed. strong narrative. can we add a one-paragraph section about expected inbound volume and lead scoring expectations?
leo (Product): +1 to that. also need 99th pct latency and single-request cost numbers — readers love concrete numbers. i'll drop the numbers in a minute.
natalie (Content): intro is a little long. can we tighten to 55-65 words and make the first sentence include the customer benefit?
maria (Marketing): yes, i can cut. new intro pushed to the doc at /docs/launch-post-draft (edited).
ellen (Sales): heads-up — when we publish, sales wants a HubSpot routing map. can we standardize UTM tags and a lead tag for "launch:optimize" so reps can filter?
sam (Growth): suggested UTMs:
```
utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=tech_playbook
```
And a lead property: launch_source = "optimize_blog"
leo (Product): added latency/cost block: 99th = 120ms (p50 22ms), approx $0.0018 per 1k tokens on recommended config. numbers are experimental.
maria (Marketing): thanks — i'll attribute them as "internal benchmark (typical workload)" in the post copy.
ops-bot: webinar-scheduler created provisional slot 2026-05-14T17:00Z; link: https://cal.example/w/abc123
ellen (Sales): can we pair a short tech-walkthrough webinar the week after publish? sales will co-host two seats for partners.
natalie (Content): for the post flow: short problem statement, tech playbook, cost/latency benchmarks, quickstart example, CTA -> sign up for webinar. do we want a separate download (pdf) of the playbook?
sam (Growth): yes — gated playbook PDF for MQL capture. inbound routing: when someone downloads, set Lifecycle Stage = marketing qualified and add tag launch_source=optimize_blog.
maria (Marketing): i'm adding a tiny form on the blog page that POSTs to our webhook. devs, sample payload below — can you confirm fields?
```
POST /webhooks/hubspot
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "company": "{{company}}",
  "utm_campaign": "optimize_launch",
  "lead_tag": "optimize_blog"
}
```
leo (Product): looks fine. can we also capture model_profile param (e.g., "gpt-opt-1") so we know which benchmark readers are referencing?
maria (Marketing): good call. adding model_profile field to the payload.
ellen (Sales): final ask — include a one-slide winner's checklist for reps in the sales kit: vertical, ideal customer signal, expected CAC range, and next-step play.
maria (Marketing): added to the doc under /ops/sales-kit. i'll ping again when everything's copy-locked. :thumbsup:
sam (Growth): timeline check — aim to lock copy by Thursday, assets by Friday, publish Tuesday. everyone good?
leo (Product): good for me.
natalie (Content): ok, i'll do final edit Thursday morning.
ellen (Sales): good from sales.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: copy-lock review in #marketing on 2026-04-16T15:00Z.
maria (Marketing): great — thanks all. will update thread when copy is locked.
